title: I always wanted to make this silly pet human game
author: baronvonpain
selftext:
I've made a few versions of this game for fun throughout the years, but even though it's just a simple virtual pet game, I always ran into some issue that made it so I couldn't immediately complete it, and so I moved on. This time I used Claude and got it all put together in full in a day and a half. It's all html, java, and css, so the graphics aren't incredible. Don't expect to be blown away. In fact, the whole game is basic. I just thought it would be funny. I have versions of this that I've built in html5, Flash, Unity, UE4 and UE5, and this is the first one that works in full.

  
[My Pet Human](https://emptynoggin.com/games/MyPetHuman/)
